last_amend_reason: ESC-009, approved by Hank in the cycle-13 turn ('approve ESC-009, do both (a) and (b)'). Two changes to tickets.json and nothing else. (a) SCOPE NARROWING on six tickets, from a directory glob to their real per-file ownership: T-032/T-034/T-035 held 'apps/exchange/tests/**' and T-042/T-043/T-044 held 'packages/store-agent/tests/**', so check-wave intersected the globs rather than the truth and vetoed all six pairs among the two trios - only one of each trio could ever be in flight. Their actual ownership is disjoint (test_ranking.py / test_bandit.py / test_loss_reports.py; test_external_bids.py / test_learning.py / test_modes.py), and each tests directory's conftest.py auto-loads uniquely-named _fixtures_<topic>.py siblings so no lane needs to edit a shared file. This WEAKENS NOTHING: the veto gets SHARPER, not looser - two lanes that would genuinely write the same file are still refused, and no lane gains the right to touch a file it could not touch before. (b) THREE PAPER EDGES DROPPED - T-034->T-032, T-035->T-032, T-045->T-044 - each contradicted by the frozen test body, read in full: the policy and reports tests import nothing from ranking and feed plain fixture dicts, and the persona test imports only the personas module and the manifest, with no signing, no door and no queue. WHY IT MATTERED: all 27 red tests in E4 (5/20) and E3 (9/21) are ImportError on seven packages that were never written, the tickets owning them had every dependency closed, and dispatch.jsonl held zero records naming T-042/T-043/T-044/T-045 across 114 entries - thirteen cycles in which the largest error in the run was never dispatched. No metric, target, acceptance test or goal changed; graph structure only, and it is validated acyclic with no dangling dependencies over 170 tickets.
